description: Advance the game: slide toward an x position and hold fire for a number of ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Returns what happened, a sky view and every alien, shot, UFO and loot pod.

fire.description: Hold fire during this step. Default true.

move_to.description: x position to slide toward at full speed (26 per second). Leave out to stay where you are.

name: step
title: Play a step
